questions.question: At which ground did Shabnim Ismail record their career-best innings (50, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl, against Boland on 2017/01/22.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Mieke de Ridder holds it, with a total of 36.

questions.question: Who has more runs — Tanya Cronje or Izel Cilliers? (T20.)
Which of these players is tied for the most provincial unions represented in a career in this database, having played for five?
questions.explanation: Janse van Rensburg played for Dolphins, Dragons, Eastern Storm, Knights and Limpopo Lillies, five unions. She's tied for the database record alongside Zizipho Mdebuka, Bernadine Bezuidenhout and Alysia Rudolph.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Knights?
At which ground did Heat record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — largest win by runs of 95, against Kei on 2018/02/11.
